attributes.context: Located in Article XVII, Management's Right to Manage; it states the Agreement does not limit the Employer's right to direct covered employees to perform maintenance, repair, modernization, and installation work involving elevators and escalators in existing or modified shafts or well ways.

extraction_text: Nothing contained in this Agreement is to be construed as a limitation of the right of the Employer to exercise the regular and customary functions of management, including the right to direct the employees, covered by this Agreement to perform all work involving the maintenance, repair and modernization of elevators and escalators, and also the installation of elevators and escalators (with the exception of a completely new elevator or escalator installation using new equipment or used equipment not part of the existing installation) in existing or modified elevator shafts or escalator well ways.

attributes.context: It is part of Article XXXIII, titled 'SECOND SHIFT MODERNIZATION WORK,' which also specifies first-shift straight-time pay, a 15% second-shift differential except for pre-March 31, 1997 contracts at 10%, voluntary second-shift employment, and a prohibition on first-shift employees working the second shift.

extraction_text: (a) Employers may staff modernization work with two (2) five (5) day eight (8) hour shifts when contractually required.
